plugin.note: Suqah strategy: use north Lunar Isle with cannon, Ranged, Protect from Magic, and the hill safespot for fastest dense kills; use south or south-west Lunar Isle with melee and cannon to avoid magic damage.

requirements: Partial completion of Lunar Diplomacy for Lunar Isle access
Seal of passage to use the Lunar Isle bank unless Dream Mentor or the Elite Fremennik Diary allows banker access
Dwarf multicannon and steel cannonballs for the recommended high-experience methods
mechanics: Suqah are aggressive level 111 monsters with 105 Hitpoints and 107.6 Slayer XP.
Suqah are 2x2 monsters and attack every 6 ticks.
The monster page lists Stab and Magic attacks with a max hit of 10.
The shield-bearing northern variety uses melee plus weaker Ice Barrage and Water Wave spells.
A successful Ice Barrage cast is guaranteed to hit 10 if the player is not using Protect from Magic.
The dual-wielding southern variety attacks only with melee.
The task page marks north Lunar Isle, south-east Lunar Isle, and south-west Lunar Isle as cannonable and safespottable.
North and south-east Lunar Isle are multicombat; south-west Lunar Isle is single-way combat.
Suqah have a 20% elemental weakness to Earth spells, but the wiki task page recommends Ranged north and melee south.
Suqah drops are low value, so cannonballs, blowpipe scales, and prayer potions can make the task coin-negative despite good experience.

methods.label: Requirements and access
methods.summary: Prepare for a Lunar Isle task with banking, teleport, and cannon assumptions handled before combat.
recommendedFor: Players choosing between north and south spawns
requiredOrKeyItems: Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport
steps: Confirm partial completion of Lunar Diplomacy before routing to Lunar Isle.
Bring a seal of passage if the account has not completed Dream Mentor or the Elite Fremennik Diary and wants to use the Lunar Isle bank.
Bring cannon parts and steel cannonballs for the fast methods described on the task page.
Bring a bonecrusher necklace or bonecrusher because Suqah always drop big bones.
Choose north Lunar Isle for dense cannon and Ranged kills, or southern Lunar Isle when avoiding magic attacks.
risks: Without seal of passage or a banking unlock, Lunar Isle bank access is unavailable.
Cannonballs, blowpipe scales, and prayer potions can cost more than the task returns.

methods.label: North ranged cannon safespot
methods.summary: Use the dense northern Lunar Isle spawns with cannon, Ranged gear, Protect from Magic, and the hill safespot.
recommendedFor: Players spending cannonballs for experience per hour
Accounts comfortable sustaining Protect from Magic
requiredOrKeyItems: Divine ranging potion or ranging potion
steps: Go to the northern part of Lunar Isle where the task page lists 16 Suqah.
Set up the dwarf multicannon in the northern area and keep it loaded while killing.
Stand next to the hill safespot shown on the task page and attack with Ranged.
Keep Protect from Magic active because northern Suqah use both melee and magic.
Wear armour with high Melee defence to reduce damage that still comes through while praying against Magic.
Use a divine ranging potion or ranging potion for faster kills.
Expect this method to be coin-negative if using toxic blowpipe and cannonballs because Suqah drops are poor.
risks: If Protect from Magic drops, Ice Barrage can successfully cast and guarantee 10 damage.
The method burns supplies quickly for experience rather than profit.
inventory: Divine ranging potion or ranging potion
Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport

methods.label: South melee cannon
methods.summary: Use southern Lunar Isle melee-only Suqah when avoiding Protect from Magic.
recommendedFor: Players who do not want to use Protect from Magic
Accounts using Guthan's equipment for sustain
requiredOrKeyItems: Divine super combat potion or super combat potion
steps: Go to the southern part of Lunar Isle, including the area near the Astral Altar, for melee-only Suqah.
Set up a dwarf multicannon if using cannonballs for faster task completion.
Use stab-focused melee weapons such as Ghrazi rapier, Osmumten's fang, Zamorakian hasta, Abyssal dagger, or Dragon sword.
Use divine super combat potions or super combat potions to maintain melee damage.
Use Guthan's equipment when prioritising sustain; the task page notes their damage can be mitigated entirely with Guthan's equipment.
Bring some food and a one-click teleport even though this method avoids magic.
risks: Southern spawns are more sparse than northern Lunar Isle, so kills can be slower.
Melee-only does not mean damage-free unless using sustain, prayer, or enough food.
inventory: 2 Divine super combat potions or super combat potions
Teleport to house tablet or other one-click teleport

methods.label: South-west melee-only cannon
methods.summary: Use the south-west bridge and dead-tree cannon placement to target melee-only Suqah while avoiding the nearby magic user.
recommendedFor: Players using cannon but not Protect from Magic
Accounts choosing the single-way south-west location
steps: Cross to the south-west part of Lunar Isle over the bridge near the city wall.
Use the three melee-only Suqah noted on the task page.
Place the cannon directly north-west of the dead tree.
This cannon placement targets melee-only Suqah while avoiding the single magic-dealing Suqah in the vicinity.
Use melee gear and sustain supplies as in the broader southern melee method.
risks: South-west Lunar Isle is single-way combat, unlike the northern and south-east rows.
Incorrect cannon placement can pull the nearby magic-using Suqah.

methods.label: Banking and supplies
methods.summary: Plan the trip around Lunar Isle bank access, cannon restocking, and the task's low-value drops.
steps: Use a seal of passage for Lunar Isle bank access unless Dream Mentor or the Elite Fremennik Diary removes that requirement.
Bring enough cannonballs for the planned task section; the north method spends them fastest.
Bring prayer potions for north Lunar Isle because Protect from Magic is recommended there.
Use food such as sharks, karambwans, or monkfish for both north and south setups.
Carry a bonecrusher necklace or bonecrusher to process big bones automatically.
risks: Forgetting seal of passage can force an early teleport or awkward banking route.
Poor Suqah drops mean supply burn should be treated as an experience cost.
